lanes.title: research-tree audit fixes (D-084): grouped prerequisite expressions, completion-coloured edges, bank-aware Civics estimates, Longbow diagnosis, tier-gap routing, date review
lanes.brief: SCOPE (D-084, READING DC1-R2 (a)): this lane may change Sim.Ui (the research screens under Sim.Ui/Progression and their tests in Sim.Ui.Tests), Sim.Core/State/InfoQuery.cs (the research estimate) with its tests, and Sim.Data/content/research.json only as DC1-R1 (a) allows, with the content tests; nothing in Sim.Core/Kernel; no permanent project; no CI change; no merge, tag or release. Read docs/d084-research-tree-audit-fixes-2026-11-10.md first, then the audit docs/m6-plan/research-tree-audit-2026-11-10.md in full, then D-070 (prerequisites in orange; the bank shown wherever Civics is shown), D-061 (Civics Points), D-068, D-072, D-073, D-047 (the causal date rule and its test), D-069 and docs/ip-originality.md, and docs/validation-policy.md. The audit is SECONDARY evidence written without running anything: verify every claim against the tree before acting on it; a claim you cannot reproduce is reported, not fixed. (1) VERIFY each finding on the current tree, by a test or a measurement: §2 (the structural results), §3, §4 (including that only 4 of the 77 mixed expressions change meaning when flattened), §5 (the three call sites), §6, §7 (the 48 candidates) and §8; record REPRODUCED, REFUTED or PARTLY with the evidence. (2) FIX the reproduced source defects, each with a test that fails before the fix: (a) §4: keep the prerequisite expression tree in the graph model and the detail pane; show grouped alternatives (for example 'Seed drill OR (Plough ard AND Horse collar)'); each atom's completion shown without losing the grouping; no per-atom 'required' or 'one of' label that misstates a nested group; truth-table tests for the four nodes (every atom combination, the canonical expression against what the UI model represents) and a corpus-wide test that every expression's UI representation keeps its truth table. (b) §3: completion state reaches edge rendering on the pinned and the non-pinned paths: a completed prerequisite's edge uses the completed semantic, an incomplete one the prerequisite semantic (orange, D-070); required and alternative styling kept; tests with mixed completed and incomplete prerequisites in both trees. (c) §5: one shared estimate function used by the tree card's state line, the selected-node pane and InfoQuery. For Civics, remaining = max(0, EffectiveCost - Progress - banked CP) and turns = ceil(remaining / CP per turn); Technology unchanged (no RP bank). First read how the engine actually spends the bank (which civic it funds, queued civics, the order within a turn) and make the estimate say what the engine will do; if the engine's rule makes the audit's formula wrong for some case, follow the engine and say so. Tests: cost 500, rate 50, bank 600 gives 0 turns; bank 450 gives 1; progress plus bank above the cost; a Technology estimate not reduced by the Civics bank; all three surfaces agree; a zero rate. (3) LONGBOW (§6): diagnose only, no content change. Show what the detail pane lists for Longbow on the current tree (the direct REQUIRES list against the Age-sweep and stage sections), with a headless capture if the UI test harness can make one, so the Director can compare it with what was seen in play; say what is needed from the Director (a screenshot of the pane and the build that was run). (4) TIER GAPS (§2.2): review the 18 edges longer than 12 tiers for routing and readability; improve routing only in the layout or rendering code, never by changing content depths; captures before and after if the harness can make them. (5) HISTORICAL REVIEW (§7): the 8 priority candidates first, then the other 40, each with labelled evidence (FETCH, SEARCH, KNOW as the research workflows define them; the session's network refuses most sites, so say what could not be checked) and a verdict: no conflict, text fix, or prerequisite question. Change research.json only to correct `emerged` description text that the evidence shows is wrong, each change listed with its source; any prerequisite change is a game-design change and is a PROPOSAL for the Director, not applied; the D-047 causal test keeps passing; no bulk correction. Write the review to docs/m6-plan/research-date-review-2026-11.md. (6) VALIDATION per docs/validation-policy.md with scripts/validate.sh: targeted after edits, integration when coherent, and full (Tier 3) because Sim.Core and possibly Sim.Data change; one full suite at a time; report what ran, what was selected but NOT RUN and why, and what was deferred. Every moved golden or pin gets a measured attribution. (7) REPORT docs/m6-plan/research-tree-fixes-2026-11.md: per-finding verdicts, what changed (files, line counts), tests, mutants (bounded, each killed by a semantic test), captures, what ran, NOT RUN, deferred, and questions for the Director only where genuinely open. MACHINE LOCK (another Sim lane runs at the same time on this 4-CPU machine): run every Tier-3 full suite (scripts/validate.sh full, or a full dotnet test of Sim.slnx) under the shared lock, for example flock /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-civDemo/54b82655-610f-500e-a185-8fae64bdd108/scratchpad/m7c/fullsuite.lock scripts/validate.sh full, so that only one full suite runs at a time on this machine (CLAUDE.md); targeted and integration runs need no lock.
